description: One search over every open agent catalog indexed at https://bazaar.agentexchange.work/universe: the Official MCP Registry, Smithery, npm packages tagged mcp-server and x402, the Apify Store, ClawHub skills, Agentverse agents, the A2A Registry, Hugging Face Spaces tagged mcp-server, the Docker MCP Catalog and x402-list. Returns name, the link to the entry on its own catalog, description, the catalog popularity number and whether it is paid. Without catalog it searches the top entries of each catalog; with catalog=<key> it searches that catalog in full. For priced x402 routes use find_resources.

catalog.description: optional: mcp-registry | smithery | npm-mcp | npm-x402 | apify | docker-mcp | x402-list | clawhub | agentverse | a2a-registry | hf-mcp

query.description: what you need: words, a product name, a protocol

name: search_all_catalogs
title: Search every agent catalog
